authoring_rules: No full source-file titles, announcement identifiers or control numbers supplied in v2 questions.
Retain natural domain terms and enough business or historical context to make each question answerable; do not artificially remove all useful keywords.
Paraphrase asks in alternate expressions; scenario asks from an applicant/exporter/company situation; multi_evidence requires two separately labeled facts.
Use explicit years for historical recruitment and contest notices; distinguish proposals, planned dates and confirmed outcomes.
Reference answers and acceptable evidence chunks come from corpus bodies, not v2 retrieved rankings.
For each requirement enumerate every matching chunk in the labeled source parents, including overlap and equivalent-format copies.
Group equivalent decree formats into one logical relevant document; raw physical-parent recall remains available separately.
Separate unanswered fact requests from answerable ranking questions; empty-gold cases are not averaged into recall.
Treat equivalent duplicate copies of the children-product notice as one logical relevant document.
Group byte-identical copies of the newly added parser sources as equivalent parents.

Exception for docs-v2-121..135 (identifier_* categories): these questions DO supply announcement identifiers and article numbers on purpose, to exercise the lexical exact-match path that the first 120 questions never touch. Do not mix their scores into paraphrase/scenario trends.
limitations: AI-authored source-reviewed draft, not independently human-reviewed or a production acceptance benchmark.
V1 results were already known; V2 is a revised development benchmark, not a blind held-out test set.
Corpus-wide exhaustive relevance judgments are not established. Recall is relative to reviewed labels.
Some remaining words necessarily overlap the source to preserve the user's business context; the set does not guarantee equal lexical difficulty for each method.
Evidence matching uses labeled chunk IDs, not automated evaluation of generated answer correctness. Relevant unlabeled paraphrase chunks may require additional human judgments.
Negative examples are scope-relative drafts for manual abstention review; current search-compare/search-evaluate reject empty gold and do not score them.
Human edits change query fingerprints. Recompute hashes in this manifest when freezing a reviewed revision.
The 120-query revision has not been used to rerun retrieval; historical 40- and 80-query results refer to earlier revisions.
The review corpus combines the prior 36-document snapshot with 16 regenerated new source files; it is not a snapshot of the complete live index.
Validate all chunk IDs and quotes against final full parser output before retrieval comparisons.
New-source relevance judgments cover 11 logical documents; other new sources may provide alternative evidence.
docs-v2-121..135 quote identifiers that mostly occur once in the review corpus, so the gold is near-unique by construction; they are a regression guard for identifier lookup, not a difficulty test.
